name: Registration as a Citizen (Commonwealth/Irish/British Protected Persons)

requirements.blocker_text: Must be a Commonwealth citizen, a citizen of Ireland, or a British protected person -- non-Commonwealth nationals instead use naturalisation (see tt_naturalisation.json).
Requires 5 years of residence in Trinidad and Tobago, though the Minister may accept a shorter period at their discretion.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of residence (or a shorter period the Minister may accept).

evidence_required.document: Application form for registration as a citizen
Proof of 5 years' residence (or shorter, at ministerial discretion)

sources.title: Citizenship of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago Act, Chapter 1:50, Section 7 (primary legislation, privately hosted mirror): registration route for Commonwealth citizens, citizens of Ireland, and British protected persons, 5-year residence with ministerial discretion to shorten

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Trinidad and Tobago's initial build. This is the parallel track to tt_naturalisation.json for the large population of Commonwealth-country nationals (most of the Caribbean, the UK, Canada, Australia, and dozens of other countries) who are explicitly barred from the naturalisation route -- the two are mutually exclusive gates on the same underlying goal (becoming a T&T citizen by residence) rather than alternative preferences. IMPORTANT: per the primary Citizenship Act text reviewed for this build, Section 7 does NOT include an independent marriage-based registration ground -- a secondary (tier-3) source claimed one exists ('registration after 7 years of marriage'), but this was not corroborated by the primary legislation and is therefore NOT modelled as a route in this dataset; see tt_permanent_residence_marriage.json's notes for the full disclosure of that conflict. No fee amount was found for this route.
